result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. `RegionManagerTest` passes, but I didn't add a test for the new order or run your T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I replaced the `ORDER BY` with the same `CASE t.priority ...` ordering that `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep` uses. I also updated the method's Javadoc. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are filtered out as before.

The only caller is `RegionManagerService`, which feeds the region overview, so nothing else needed changing.
